Paul Ludwig Hans Anton von Beneckendorff und von Hindenburg [ a ] (2 October 1847 – 2 August 1934) was a German military officer and statesman who led the Imperial German Army during World War I [ 1 ] and later became President of Germany from 1925 until his death in 1934. Though ideologically opposed to Nazism , he played a key role in the Nazi seizure of power in 1933 through his appointment of Adolf Hitler as Chancellor of Germany . [ 1 ]
